description.value: The Curious Café is a downtown Kelowna restaurant built around wood-fired Neapolitan-style pizza, casual comfort food, and craft cocktails in a relaxed, welcoming space. The café features a seasonal patio, a private speakeasy-style room seating up to 30 guests, and offsite catering — making it a flexible destination for solo riders and group cycling trips alike. Its central Ellis Street location in the heart of Kelowna places it within easy reach of the Okanagan Rail Trail and downtown waterfront cycling routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the address (1423 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC), phone (778.484.0490), and that this is an active, dine-in restaurant serving wood-fired pizza, brunch, craft cocktails, and comfort food. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water bottle refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website text, so all cycling-specific required criteria remain null. The website footer consistently names the business 'The Curious Artistry & Alchemy Café', which differs from the OSM name 'The Curious café' — this discrepancy is flagged.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Curious café' but the website footer consistently uses the longer name 'The Curious Artistry & Alchemy Café' — the registered or trading name may differ from the OSM entry.
Two different contact email addresses appear across website pages (kimberly@coccarogroup.com and luigi@coccarogroup.com), suggesting an inconsistency in the website itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active downtown restaurant in a cycling-friendly area, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification of bike parking and basic cyclist amenities is needed before including.
